eval.title: Tesla Stock Serious Discussion - TESLA IS A REMARKABLE BUSINESS!!!

call.headline_quote: tesla for me is just an amazing business but a risky investment and that's it

what_is_priced_in.quote: 50 growth rate is what elon said

reasons.claim: The automotive industry has no barrier to entry and huge capital is flowing into competitors, so a durable moat for Tesla is unproven.
reasons.quote: the automotive industry all these industries where you have no barrier of entry anybody can entry and there is plenty of money chasing those entry opportunities simply it's risky

reasons.claim: He avoids investing on exuberance and promises, having watched dot-com, real-estate, 3D-printing and marijuana bubbles blow up after similar hype.
reasons.quote: i don't like this exuberance i don't like this investing on promises i prefer fundamentals

reasons.claim: Tesla's car sales have more than quadrupled in a few years and management plans 50% annual growth, which is remarkable if achieved.
reasons.quote: their plan is to grow 50 per year over the next year's multi-year horizon so that is really remarkable and also possible

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.5, as-of -1.13008 (FY2020); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Tesla's high market cap lets it raise cheap capital (issuing ~10% of shares for $60bn) which funds huge investment and improves fundamentals, a reflexive dynamic.
reasons.quote: issuing 10 of shares is not a high cost now and that's something again remarkable from a financial perspective

data_check.gap_note: he says 6e+11, as-of 2.04925e+11 (FY2020); annual vs TTM or a different definition; not in our data: share issuance

reasons.claim: Because he cannot confirm a lasting moat and the outcome is too uncertain, he prefers to wait until Tesla proves itself rather than invest now.
reasons.quote: as i said when tesla will really show that it has a mode there will be time to invest i'm not that greedy that i need to chase this growth stocks

external_facts_used: Tesla's planned 50% annual growth rate as stated by Elon Musk
Daimler, GM, Audi, Volkswagen EV investment figures (85bn, 27bn, etc.)
ARK's projection of a $3 trillion market cap for Tesla
Elon Musk's statement that Tesla was close to bankruptcy two years earlier
Seth Klarman's purchase of Tesla convertible bonds

critic.notes: Extractor says too_hard; he does judge the business (no moat, too much competition, too risky, would only invest when moat proven or via Tencent) so avoid fits better, but both map to SELL.
